usage: Chinese basil is a commonly used herb, especially in Chinese cooking.
It has a strong aroma and is great for enhancing flavour.
It can usually be bought at wet markets or supermarkets.
Fresh Chinese basil leaves are bright green and very fragrant.
Besides stir-frying, Chinese basil can also be added to soups or congee for extra flavour.
